posts.text: 2w Your migration can turn a paying subscriber into a decline. For a recurring payment to work, the network needs to recognize its link to the customer’s original consent. Those identifiers often live inside the current payment setup. Move processors without preserving that chain and an established subscriber can look like a first-time payer. The card has not necessarily changed. The proof that it belongs to a valid recurring agreement may be missing. Network tokens have their own relationship and onboarding dependencies.
